message.content:
This editorial illustration features three human figures sitting on a long wooden bench against a plain white background. At the top, the large red text "TEMPO" is positioned above "17-23 MARET 2014". Further up, black text includes "ERIC CLAPTON: LAPORAN DARI SINGAPURA", "BABAK BARU KASUS CENTURY", and "PATGULIPAT IMPOR SEMEN ILEGAL". Below the main title is the black heading "DRAMA JOKOWI", followed by "Di balik penetapan Gubernur DKI sebagai calon presiden dari PDI Perjuangan."

The figures sit with their backs partially or fully turned. On the left, a person with long dark hair tied back wears a light blue long-sleeved shirt and red trousers. In the center, a person with short dark hair wears a red short-sleeved shirt and sits with legs crossed at the ankles. On the right, a person with short dark hair and side profile visible wears a light blue long-sleeved shirt and dark trousers. The bench has five dark brown wooden slats for the backrest and three for the seat, supported by two grey concrete or stone-like pillars. The figures' feet are visible: the left person wears light blue heels, the center person is barefoot, and the right person wears black shoes with red soles. A barcode and "RP 35.000" are at the bottom left.
